Aka-chan Doubutsuen.name: Aka-chan Doubutsuen
Aka-chan Doubutsuen.summary: Cutesy virtual pet/adventure game from TDK Core, released only in Japan. Take care of little baby animals, including giraffes, pandas, elephants, koalas, and monkeys -- giggle excitedly over their cuteness and train them to pull off happy little tricks. Features more than 160 different animals from over 40 species.

F-Zero - GP Legend.name: F-Zero: GP Legend
F-Zero - GP Legend.summary: The F-Zero series grows with new racing circuits, an intense storyline, and multiplayer modes. F-Zero GP Legend lets you take control of one of eight characters, including Captain Falcon, racing star Rick Wheeler, the evil lord Black Shadow, and more. Guide your character through various Grand Prix cups, time trials, and challenges that span multiple planets. In addition to conquering single-player challenges, you can challenge up to three of your friends in multiplayer competitions.

Harvest Moon - More Friends of Mineral T.name: Harvest Moon: More Friends of Mineral Town
Harvest Moon - More Friends of Mineral T.summary: Live the simple life as a farmer in Harvest Moon: More Friends of Mineral Town. This game is similar to the original Harvest Moon: Friends of Mineral Town, but now you can play as a girl who has left the city to pursue a life on the farm. You'll take part in growing crops, managing livestock, finding a husband, and raising children.

Kurohige no Golf Shiyouyo.name: Kurohige no Golf Shiyouyo
Kurohige no Golf Shiyouyo.summary: Kurohige no Golf Shiyouyo is a Sports game, developed by Inti Creates and published by Tomy Corporation, which was released in Japan in 2002.

Little Buster Q.name: Little Buster Q
Little Buster Q.summary: Little Buster Q is a Role-Playing game, developed by Amedio and published by Tomy Corporation, which was released in Japan in 2002.

Sentouin Yamada Hajime.name: Sentouin: Yamada Hajime
Sentouin Yamada Hajime.summary: Sentouin: Yamada Hajime is an Action game, developed by Rokumendo and published by Kids Station, which was released in Japan in 2004.

Twin Series 3 - Konchuu Monster - Ouja K.name: Twin Series Vol. 3: Konchuu Monster - Ouja Ketteisen + Super Chinese Labyrinth
Twin Series 3 - Konchuu Monster - Ouja K.summary: The third game in Culture Brain's Twin Series compiles a bug battle sim with Super Chinese Labyrinth.
